sources.title: dia: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Dia is a 1.6 billion parameter text-to-dialogue audio generation model developed by Nari Labs and packaged for Replicate by zsxkib. It generates realistic dialogue audio directly from text, supporting multiple speakers using speaker tags like [S1] and [S2], non-verbal cues in parentheses (such as (laughs) or (whispers)), and voice cloning from reference audio.
